origine_fr: Deux mains, 彐 et 寸. Autrefois 尋, c'était la longueur des deux bras tendus, huit pieds. Le mot a pris le sens de « chercher ».
origine_en: Two hands, 彐 and 寸. Once written 尋, it was the span of both outstretched arms, eight feet. The word came to mean “to look for”.

phrase.pinyin: Tā zài xúnzhǎo tā de gǒu.
phrase.en: He is looking for his dog.
